title: Action Taken By Public Safety Bureau Police In Accident Between Motor Car And Handcart On Connaught Road West Of The Bus Company

page_data.en:
Fm. 2
G. 35000-1-34

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Misc. 32 34
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
Gordon Road Station, 4543/9
Date May 16 1934.

Subject (in full) Action taken by Public Safety Bureau Police in accident
between motor car and handcart on Connaught Road west of
the Bus Company.

Made by D.S.I.Rhind Forwarded by Sedgwick Lofft.

Sir,

At 10.30 a.m. on May 16, 1934, one Young San Di (黄三弟)
telephoned to the Gordon Road Station reporting that motor car
Settlement License No.3899 of which he is the chauffeur, was in
collision with a handcart on the Connaught Road nearby the pre-
mises of the Bus Company.

F.S.Klock went to the scene immediately, but the
chauffeur Young Sai Di and the other parties involved were not
to be found there when he arrived. He learned that the chauffeur
and the coolie in charge of the handcart had been taken away by
uniform policemen of the Public Safety Bureau. He found the motor
car and the handcart standing parallel to the south footpath
on Connaught Road about 100 yards west of the Bus Company. The
near side front wheel of the former vehicle was buckled and the
two front mudguards were badly dented while the handcart bore
no sign of damage. No persons were injured in the collision, and
there were no police witnesses, either P.S.B. or S.M.P. What
seemed to have happened judging by the statements of witnesses
was that the handcart loaded with timber extending far in front
of the vehicle was proceeding west on Connaught Road when it
swerved slightly towards the middle of the road so as to avoid
a private ricksha that was standing alongside the south kerb and
came into collision with the motor car which, coming from the
opposite direction, was going towards the south footpath pre-
paratory to pulling up.

The Officer i/c of the Gordon Road Station being
out on a tour of inspection in the district, D.S.I.Rhind and
C.D.C.217 attended later in response to a telephone call from
F.S.Klock, and S.I. Primrose was sent shortly afterwards. A

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
杂项 32 34
报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
档案号 S. B. 登记处。
戈登路捕房，4543/9
日期 1934年5月16日。

主题（全称） 公共安全局警察在公共汽车公司西侧康纳路上发生的汽车与手推车相撞事故中采取的行动。

撰写人：副督察 Rhind 转呈人：Sedgwick Lofft。

先生，

1934年5月16日上午10时30分，一名叫黄三弟（Young San Di）的人致电戈登路捕房报告称，他担任司机的租界牌照第3899号汽车，在公共汽车公司附近的康纳路上与一辆手推车发生碰撞。

F.S. Klock 立即赶赴现场，但当他到达时，司机 Young Sai Di 及其他相关方已不在现场。他获悉，司机和负责手推车的苦力已被公共安全局的制服警察带走。他发现汽车和手推车停在康纳路上，位于公共汽车公司以西约100码处，平行于南侧人行道。前者的近侧前轮弯曲，两个前挡泥板严重凹陷，而手推车则没有损坏迹象。碰撞中无人受伤，也没有公共安全局或工部局警务处的警察目击者。根据证人的陈述，当时的情形似乎是：装载着向前伸出很长的木材的手推车正沿康纳路向西行驶，为了避让停靠在南侧路缘边的一辆私人人力车，手推车略微向路中间偏转，结果与迎面驶来、正准备靠向南侧人行道停车的汽车发生碰撞。

由于戈登路捕房主管正在辖区内巡视，副督察 Rhind 和刑事侦缉警员 C.D.C.217 随后应 F.S. Klock 的电话呼叫赶到现场，巡官 Primrose 也在不久后被派往现场。一

P.S.B. Policeman at the scene referred the detectives to the
Kung Ka Jan Sub-Station to which the chauffeur and the coolie
in charge of the handcart had been taken. On a visit to this
station, it was found that the personnel there were not prepared
to release either the chauffeur or the coolie, and that it was
their intention to transfer the case to the 6th Division Station
for necessary action. With the object of expediting the release
of the two parties, and realising that there was no other alter-
native, D.S.I. Rhind conveyed them to the 6th Division Station
in charge of P.S.B. Policeman. At the 6th Division Station it
was claimed that Colonel Tan, the Officer in charge, was absent
in Nantao, and that both the chauffeur and coolie would have to
remain in custody until such time as he returned, and gave the
matter his attention. D.S.I. Rhind requested an interview with
the deputy, but this was denied on the ground that he had no
power to enter into a discussion about the matter. With that the
detectives left and on their way back to the Station met Inspector
Holt on Connaught Road being conveyed to the scene of the accident
by the station motor cycle. It was then ascertained that the
owner of the motor car was one Mr. Wang Hong Shing(王洪興)
residing at 3/884 Gordon Road. This person was called immediately
and he went with Inspector Holt and D.S.I. Rhind to the 6th Division
Station. The attitude adopted by the personnel was the same as
before, all of them asserting that Colonel Tan had not yet returned
and that his deputy was not in position to discuss the matter.
After a wait of about 25 minutes, Inspector Holt in compliance
with a request made by him was allowed to communicate with Col.
Tan by telephone and in consequence of this the latter gave in-
structions to his deputy to release the chauffeur and the handcart

名在现场的公共安全局警察将侦探指引至龚家镇分驻所，司机和手推车苦力被带往该处。经前往该分驻所查看，发现那里的人员不准备释放司机或苦力，并打算将此案移交第六分区捕房以采取必要行动。为了加快释放这两人，并意识到别无他法，副督察 Rhind 在一名公共安全局警察的看管下将他们送往第六分区捕房。在第六分区捕房，对方声称主管谭上校（Colonel Tan）去了南市，司机和苦力必须一直拘留到他回来处理此事为止。副督察 Rhind 要求会见副手，但遭到拒绝，理由是副手无权就此事项进行讨论。侦探们随即离开，在返回捕房的途中，在康纳路上遇到了霍尔特（Holt）巡官，他正乘坐捕房的摩托车前往事故现场。此时查明，汽车车主为王洪興（Wang Hong Shing），居住在戈登路3/884号。此人立即被召来，并与霍尔特巡官及副督察 Rhind 一同前往第六分区捕房。那里人员的态度与之前相同，均声称谭上校尚未返回，其副手无法就此事项进行讨论。等待约25分钟后，霍尔特巡官应其请求获准通过电话与谭上校联系，因此后者指示其副手释放司机和手推车

no action should be taken and gave a written understanding to
that effect. To these conditions the owner of the motor car
willingly acceded and the chauffeur and the coolie were allowed
to be taken away by Inspector Holt. However, about ten yards
from the station the coolie was recalled for the purpose of
"further enquiries" and was not actually released until 3 (ok) p.m.
This coolie is named Kyi You Tsang (救有章) and he is
employed with the Yuen Dah Lumber Coy, Jessfield Road.
A complete report of the accident was ultimately record-
ed at the Gordon Road Station.
